description: List requests on the network, newest first. Filter by status (open, claimed, submitted, disputed, completed, cancelled, expired, refunded; comma-separated), category, or your own (mine = requester or helper). Use it to browse open public work or to see your requests.

mine.description: Only your requests: requester (you asked) or helper (you work on it).

status.description: Comma-separated statuses, e.g. open or submitted,disputed.

token.description: Optional API key (zck_...), session token or guest requester_token for this call only. Overrides the connection's Authorization header. Use it to follow up on a request you posted as a guest.

name: list_requests
title: List requests
